templates.notes: Sungrow residential hybrid inverter template implemented against protocol V1.1.11 (2025-11-17). Register addresses are zero-based (documentation register - 1). U32/S32 use low-word-first word order and big-endian bytes. EMS writes only power setpoints; the adapter writes EMS mode + charge/discharge command + power as one FC16 block over 13050..13052, keeps External EMS heartbeat 13080 at fixed 20 s, and treats charge/discharge helper datapoints as mutually exclusive so an older delayed charge command cannot overwrite a new discharge command. RW helper registers are not fast-polled; request cadence is kept at >=1000 ms per Sungrow requirements. One-second control telemetry: the critical fast datapoints are scheduled with a fixed 1000 ms start-to-start target; Modbus TCP operations use a 200 ms gap so the four fast register groups can complete inside the target cycle. Exact 0 W and the 0.5.133 charge/discharge direction mapping remain unchanged.

postWriteRepeat.disabledReason: Sungrow command direction is mutually exclusive. External EMS heartbeat keeps the control mode alive; delayed setpoint repeats could replay an older charge/discharge helper and overwrite the latest command.

setpointKeepalive.disabledReason: Sungrow External EMS/VPP heartbeat is refreshed separately; power/mode/command are written only on EMS setpoint changes, restore, or the single post-write repeat.

sungrowFastFeedback.description: Normal fast polling runs every second; additionally read battery power once immediately after each EMS setpoint write.

notes.0.5.138: Sungrow critical live values target a fixed 1 s start-to-start poll cadence. A cycle contains four Modbus TCP register groups.

templates.notes: Implementation of the official CH-W-B networking guide 2759890000/00/03.2021. Modbus TCP uses port 502 and server/unit address 255. Register addresses are used exactly as printed in the guide. Multi-register values are low-16-bit-word first with normal Modbus byte order. templates.notes: The official CMI JSON API is read-only and limited to one request per minute. This driver reads every supported value of every configured/discovered CAN node dynamically.
